title: 第11章 返回炼气五层进化路线第12章 血玉蜂炼制岩金剑
content_zh:
半个月后，顾景元炼化丹药。
时间也刚好来到第二个月底了。
顾景元将第二个月住院落的两块灵石交给了石依珊，对方不要，说是石锋嘱咐了。
但顾景元还是留下了两块灵石，他不喜欢欠人情。
离开院落之后，顾景元前往百宝阁。
出售两柄黑铁剑，被压了一点价，最后到手八十六块灵石。
然后又购买了四瓶聚灵丹，一瓶炼灵丹。
炼灵丹是炼气五层修士的修炼丹药。
四瓶聚灵丹一共两百二十块下品灵石，炼灵丹七十块下品灵石。
聚灵丹和炼灵丹都比平常虚高五块灵石。
没办法，之前仙宫出世导致不少修士的储物袋被拿走了，一时间物价抬高些。
然后又购买了三瓶灵兽丸，一瓶灵蜜丹。
总共三百零一块灵石，最后便宜了一块灵石。
然后又花六块灵石购买了不少食物，肉干。
“还剩下一百八十块下品灵石了，不过这次回去之后，我要一举突破炼气五层，到时候独自前往山脉猎杀妖兽也有底气了。”
出了坊市，顾景元一路疾驰。
中间多次故意绕路隐藏，想看看有没有人跟随。
好在并没有。
四天后，顾景元返回沧澜峰洞府。
再次回来，顾景元狠狠松了一口气。

赤玉振翅飞来，依旧没有突破一阶下品。
顾景元也是无奈，拿出灵蜜丹喂养，其余几只红玉蜂则是喂养灵兽丸。
紧接着来到灵泉眼旁边，浇灌，松土。
“接下来就要不断炼化丹药，尽快达到炼气四层后期圆满了。”
说着，来到石床上，盘膝闭目，开始修炼金灵锻元功。
四瓶聚灵丹，一共二十颗，平均十天一颗的话，能支撑七个月，再配合灵泉眼的灵气，他有把握修炼到炼气四层后期圆满。
吞吐，吸收灵气，运转功法炼化，淬炼体魄，归于丹田。
一个周天，两个周天，三个周天......
红玉蜂巢上洞口的光亮了又暗，暗了又亮，周而复始.....
两个月后，
洞中，此刻顾景元没有修炼，而是惊喜的看着前方一只红玉蜂，正是蜂后赤玉。
此刻赤玉比之前又大了一圈，更重要的是，赤玉此刻周身散发灵气波动。
“一阶下品，终于突破了。”
喂食了灵兽丸和灵蜜丹，加上这灵泉眼的灵气，时隔一年多才突破。
将剩下的灵蜜丹喂给赤玉，顾景元再次进入闭关修炼状态。
一个月，两个月，三个月...
时间飞逝，转眼间顾景元又闭关了六个月。
content_en:
Half a month later, Gu Jingyuan refined the elixir.
The time has just come to the end of the second month.
Gu Jingyuan gave Shi Yishan the two spiritual stones that had been kept in the hospital for the second month. The other party didn't want them, saying that Shi Feng had asked them to do so.
But Gu Jingyuan still left two spiritual stones. He didn't like to owe favors.
After leaving the courtyard, Gu Jingyuan went to Baibao Pavilion.
I sold two black iron swords at a slightly lower price, and finally got eighty-six spiritual stones.
Then he bought four bottles of Spirit Gathering Pill and one bottle of Spirit Refining Pill.
Spirit Refining Pill is a cultivation elixir for fifth-level Qi Refining monks.
The four bottles of Spirit Gathering Pill cost a total of 220 low-grade spiritual stones, and the Spirit Refining Pill cost 70 low-grade spiritual stones.
The Spirit Gathering Pill and the Spirit Refining Pill are both five spiritual stones higher than usual.
There was no way, the birth of Immortal Palace had caused many monks' storage bags to be taken away, and prices were raised for a while.
Then he bought three bottles of Spiritual Beast Pills and one bottle of Spiritual Honey Pill.
A total of three hundred and one spirit stones, and one spirit stone was cheaper in the end.
Then he spent six spiritual stones to buy a lot of food and dried meat.
"There are still one hundred and eighty low-grade spiritual stones left, but after I go back this time, I will break through the fifth level of Qi refining in one fell swoop. Then I will have the confidence to go to the mountains alone to hunt monsters."
After leaving Fangshi, Gu Jingyuan galloped all the way.
I deliberately took many detours to hide in the middle, just to see if anyone was following me.
Fortunately not.
Four days later, Gu Jingyuan returned to Canglan Peak Cave Mansion.
When he came back again, Gu Jingyuan breathed a sigh of relief.
Red Jade fluttered its wings and flew over, but it still hadn't broken through the first level of low-grade.
Gu Jingyuan was helpless and took out the Spiritual Honey Pill to feed, while the other red jade bees fed the Spiritual Beast Pill.
Then he came to the spiritual spring, watered it, and loosened the soil.
"Next, we must continue to refine the elixirs and reach the final stage of the fourth level of Qi refining as soon as possible."
With that said, he came to the stone bed, crossed his legs and closed his eyes, and began to practice the Golden Spirit Forging Yuan Gong.
There are four bottles of spirit-gathering pills, a total of twenty pills. If one pill is given every ten days on average, it can last for seven months. Coupled with the spiritual energy from the spiritual spring eye, he is sure to reach the final stage of the fourth level of Qi refining.
Inhale and exhale, absorb spiritual energy, run the exercises to refine, temper the body, and return to the Dantian.
One Sunday, two Sundays, three Sundays...
The light at the entrance of the ruby beehive brightens and dims, dims and brightens again, over and over...
Two months later,
In the cave, Gu Jingyuan was not practicing at the moment, but looked at the red jade bee in front of him in surprise, which was none other than the queen bee, Red Jade.
At this moment, Akadema is bigger than before. More importantly, Akadama is emitting spiritual energy fluctuations all over his body.
"The first-order low-grade finally broke through."
After feeding the Spiritual Beast Pills and Spiritual Honey Pills, plus the spiritual energy from this spiritual spring eye, it took more than a year to achieve a breakthrough.
After feeding the remaining Spirit Honey Pill to Chiyu, Gu Jingyuan once again entered the state of seclusion and practice.
One month, two months, three months...
Time flies, and in the blink of an eye, Gu Jingyuan has been in seclusion for another six months.
